name: Mazda MX-5
details: The Mazda MX-5 Miata RF is the purest expression of driving joy available today. Its retractable fastback roof, lightweight chassis, and perfectly balanced rear-wheel-drive layout create an intimate connection between driver and road that few cars can match.

name: Bugatti Chiron
details: An absolute masterclass in extreme mechanical engineering. The Chiron Super Sport pairs an ungodly quad-turbocharged W16 engine with ultra-refined aerodynamics, reshaping the absolute boundaries of production vehicle top speed thresholds.

name: Porsche 911
details: Essentially a street-legal race car. Utilizing an advanced active DRS drag reduction wing architecture and a high-revving naturally aspirated flat-six, it is the ultimate precision track-day weapon optimized entirely for downforce.

name: Ferrari LaFerrari
details: Maranello's definitive hybrid masterpiece. Blending an screaming F1-derived atmospheric V12 engine with a highly sophisticated electric KERS system, it delivers an uninterrupted linear torque curve.

name: McLaren P1
details: Part of the legendary hypercar holy trinity. The P1 combines a twin-turbo V8 engine with a high-performance electric motor alongside an adjustable rear wing capable of throwing down intense race-mode ground pressure.

name: Koenigsegg Regera
details: An engineering marvel utilizing a Direct Drive system instead of a traditional gearbox. Combines a twin-turbo V8 with three electric motors to provide instant, limitless velocity.

name: Lamborghini Aventador
details: The pinnacle of rowdy, old-school Italian performance. Features an untamed naturally aspirated V12 engine operating alongside ALA 2.0 active aerodynamics, locking down track stability through high-speed curves.

name: Nissan GT-R
details: Affectionately dubbed 'Godzilla.' The GT-R Nismo introduces professional motorsport dampers, custom carbon body panel layouts, and an advanced ATTESA E-TS all-wheel-drive mapping configuration.

name: Chevrolet Corvette
details: America's mid-engine disruptor. The C8 Z06 houses the most powerful naturally aspirated production V8 ever made, yielding an exotic flat-plane crank tone that revs straight to an 8,600 RPM redline.

name: Audi R8
details: An iconic everyday supercar. Sharing its structural aluminum blueprint and a high-revving naturally aspirated V10 architecture with the Lamborghini Huracán, it layers raw performance with everyday comfort.

name: Pagani Huayra
details: Automotive art brought to life. Merging a robust carbo-titanium structural monocoque with a specialized twin-turbo Mercedes-AMG V12 power unit, the Huayra balances performance with meticulous luxury design.

name: Lexus LFA
details: Famed for delivering arguably the finest acoustic experience in motoring history. The LFA's high-revving V10 engine, co-developed alongside Yamaha, runs from idle to its redline so quickly it required a digital tachometer.

name: Ford GT
details: A road-adapted Le Mans prototype built around a lightweight carbon tub. Flying buttress aerodynamic channels route oncoming airflow tightly into a high-output, twin-turbocharged EcoBoost V6 engine layout.

name: Aston Martin Vantage
details: A sculptural masterpiece balancing raw British muscularity with unmatched luxury. Powered by a potent AMG-sourced twin-turbo V8, it corners with predatory precision.

name: Rimac Nevera
details: Reconfiguring performance limits via absolute electrification. Driven by four distinct independent permanent-magnet electric motors, it handles infinite torque-vectoring adjustments up to 100 times per second.

name: Toyota GR Supra
details: A balanced, rear-wheel-drive sports coupe built with a near-perfect 50:50 weight distribution. Powered by a responsive twin-scroll inline-six engine, it delivers sharp driving feedback at an approachable scale.

name: Mercedes-AMG
details: A brutal front-engined sports machine. It features a handcrafted biturbo V8, an active rear-axle steering layout, and a highly customizable track pacing computing interface.

name: BMW M4
details: The definitive track-focused executive coupe. Utilizing high-pressure inline-six twin-turbo dynamics alongside active damping structures, it creates aggressive handling with a razor-sharp front-end bite.

name: Dodge Charger
details: Unadulterated American heavy metal. Housing a massive supercharged HEMI V8, its widebody stance wraps massive performance tires to keep almost 800 horsepower pinned straight to the blacktop.

name: Nissan Z
details: A classic tribute to heritage JDM tuning. Merging throwback styling details with a modern twin-turbocharged V6 heart, it prioritizes tail-happy analogue driving mechanics over sterile computer assists.

name: Honda Civic
details: The ultimate front-wheel-drive track weapon. Features a high-revving turbocharged engine and a brilliantly engineered limited-slip differential that maximizes corner exit speed.

name: Subaru WRX
details: A rally-bred legend that combines symmetrical all-wheel drive with a turbocharged boxer engine for unmatched grip and tenacity on loose surfaces.

name: Toyota GR86
details: A pure, lightweight rear-drive sports car. Its naturally aspirated flat-four engine delivers linear power, making it an ideal canvas for grassroots motorsports.

name: Mitsubishi Lancer
details: The final iteration of a rally giant. Uses an advanced S-AWC all-wheel-drive system to devastating effect, effortlessly putting down power through challenging corners.

name: Acura NSX
details: A technological tour de force. This hybrid supercar utilizes three electric motors alongside its twin-turbo V6 to create a surgically precise, all-wheel-drive handling experience.

name: Lexus LC
details: A breathtakingly beautiful luxury grand tourer. Its naturally aspirated V8 provides a thunderous soundtrack that perfectly matches its striking, origami-inspired exterior design.

name: Volkswagen Golf
details: A wolf in sheep's clothing. The Golf R combines a sophisticated all-wheel-drive system with a punchy turbocharged engine to create an immensely capable daily driver.

name: Hyundai Elantra
details: A surprisingly capable track-ready sedan. Features an integrated drive axle to reduce weight and an electronic limited-slip differential for aggressive cornering.

name: BMW M2
details: An aggressive, wide-bodied pocket rocket. The M2 CS offers uncompromised steering feel and a raucous inline-six engine that loves to rev.

name: Audi RS3
details: A five-cylinder symphony paired with brutal acceleration. The RS3's Quattro all-wheel-drive system and torque vectoring rear differential make it launch like a rocket.

name: Mercedes-AMG
details: A technological powerhouse replacing its V8 with a high-output hybrid inline-four. The electric motor provides massive low-end torque, completely changing the AMG formula.

name: Cadillac CT5-V
details: The swan song of the internal combustion performance sedan. Offers an optional 6-speed manual and a roaring supercharged V8, delivering old-school American luxury muscle.

name: Porsche 718
details: A mid-engine masterpiece that revs to a stratospheric 9,000 RPM. Its naturally aspirated flat-six provides visceral feedback that makes it a favorite among purists.

name: Alpine
details: A lightweight French sports car built for agility. Its mid-engine layout and low curb weight allow it to carve through mountain passes with telepathic precision.

name: Lotus
details: The final petrol-powered Lotus. Combines stunning aerodynamic design with a tuned Toyota V6 to create a beautifully balanced and surprisingly refined sports car.

name: Toyota GR Corolla
details: An absolute firecracker of a hatchback. Features a heavily reinforced GR-FOUR all-wheel-drive system and a manual transmission to channel its aggressive turbo power.

name: Honda Accord
details: A surprisingly engaging daily driver. The 2.0T engine paired with a 10-speed automatic offers smooth, accessible power wrapped in a sophisticated chassis.

name: Mazda 3
details: A premium compact car that prioritizes driving feel. Its turbocharged engine delivers a healthy dose of power to its elegantly styled, driver-focused cabin.

name: Kia Stinger
details: The car that proved Kia could build a genuine performance machine. Its twin-turbo V6 and rear-wheel-drive bias make it a comfortable yet rapid continent-crusher.

name: Genesis G70
details: A luxury sports sedan offering immense value. Features a punchy twin-turbo V6, a limited-slip differential, and a beautifully crafted interior.

name: BMW M5
details: A 4-door missile disguised as an executive transport. The M5 CS adds aggressive carbon fiber aero and increased boost to create the ultimate stealth fighter.

name: Mercedes-AMG
details: A brutally fast luxury barge. The E63 S marries immense twin-turbo V8 power with a lavishly appointed interior, making long-distance travel violently quick.

name: Audi
details: The ultimate family hauler. This twin-turbo V8 wagon offers supercar-slaying acceleration while possessing enough cargo space for a week-long family vacation.

name: Porsche Panamera
details: A luxury limousine with the soul of a sports car. The Panamera Turbo S uses an advanced 8-speed PDK and active suspension to defy physics.

name: Maserati Ghibli
details: An Italian luxury sedan with an absolutely intoxicating V8 exhaust note. The Trofeo trim adds Ferrari-derived power to a striking, aggressive body.

name: Bentley Continental
details: Effortless, continent-crushing velocity wrapped in handcrafted luxury. Its W12 engine provides a tsunami of torque, making high-speed cruising completely serene.

name: Aston Martin
details: The successor to the iconic DB11. It raises the bar significantly with a heavily upgraded twin-turbo V8, delivering true supercar performance in a timeless, elegant silhouette.

name: Rolls-Royce
details: The pinnacle of electric luxury. The Spectre glides on a wave of silent, instantaneous torque, redefining what it means to travel in absolute opulence.

name: Mercedes-Maybach
details: The ultimate expression of rear-seat comfort and prestige. Its twin-turbo V12 ensures that this massive luxury liner moves with surprising, silent authority.

name: BMW
details: A technological flagship. The 760i combines a silky smooth V8 with an array of executive rear-seat features, including a massive 31-inch theater screen.

name: Audi
details: A masterclass in serene travel. The long-wheelbase A8 isolates passengers from the outside world using predictive active suspension and expert sound deadening.

name: Porsche Taycan
details: An electric car that genuinely feels like a Porsche. Incredible launch control, rear-axle steering, and a two-speed rear transmission make it a cornering marvel.

name: Tesla Model S
details: A brutal disruptor in the performance sedan segment. Its tri-motor setup and yoke steering wheel deliver mind-warping acceleration and advanced autonomous capabilities.

name: Lucid Air
details: A technological masterpiece offering over 500 miles of range. Its ultra-efficient electric motors and sleek aerodynamics make it the most advanced EV on the market.

name: BMW i7
details: Combining immense electric power with executive luxury. The M70 trim adds staggering acceleration to a cabin featuring a massive 31-inch 8K rear theater screen.

name: Mercedes-Benz
details: The electric S-Class. Features the stunning Hyperscreen dashboard and a beautifully crafted, wind-tunnel-optimized cabin that floats over the road.

name: Rivian
details: An adventurous, family-friendly electric SUV. With a quad-motor setup, tank turns, and genuine off-road capability, it redefines the modern outdoor vehicle.

name: BMW iX
details: A futuristic, heavily sculpted electric SUV. The M60 variant brings massive torque and aggressive styling to BMW's flagship electric utility vehicle.

name: Audi
details: A stunningly beautiful electric grand tourer. Shares its platform with the Taycan but adds Audi's signature Quattro all-wheel-drive tuning and aggressive RS aesthetics.

name: Porsche Macan
details: The sports car of the SUV world. The Macan GTS features a raspy V6, sharp steering, and a suspension setup that encourages spirited driving on winding roads.

name: Lamborghini Urus
details: A raging bull in SUV form. The Performante adds carbon fiber aero, stiffer suspension, and more power to create the fastest production SUV around a track.

name: Porsche Cayenne
details: An absolute track weapon disguised as a family hauler. Its twin-turbo V8 and sophisticated active aero allow it to lap the Nürburgring faster than many sports cars.

name: BMW X5
details: A high-performance luxury SUV that blends massive V8 power with a surprisingly comfortable ride. It excels at both rapid cross-country touring and enthusiastic backroad driving.

name: Mercedes-AMG
details: An iconic, boxy legend powered by a handcrafted biturbo V8. The G63 is utterly impractical yet immensely desirable, offering brute force with undeniable luxury.

name: Alpina
details: A subtly enhanced, ultra-exclusive take on the X7. Alpina adds bespoke tuning, luxurious details, and a distinct exhaust note to create the ultimate flying suite.

name: Jeep Grand Cherokee
details: A 707-horsepower family SUV that can smoke its tires from a standstill. The Trackhawk stuffs a Hellcat engine into a Cherokee, creating absurd, hilarious performance.

name: Dodge Durango
details: The fastest three-row SUV ever built. It can tow a boat while simultaneously outrunning most sports cars thanks to its legendary supercharged V8.

name: Cadillac Escalade-V
details: A massive, luxurious American statement piece. The Escalade-V brings supercharged V8 power to a massively imposing, tech-heavy luxury SUV chassis.

name: Audi
details: The Nürburgring lap record holder for production SUVs. Combines Quattro all-wheel-drive brilliance with a burly twin-turbo V8 in a sharp, aggressive package.

name: Range Rover Sport
details: British luxury meets aggressive V8 power. The SVR provides an incredibly composed ride on the highway and astonishing off-road capability when the pavement ends.

name: Ford Mustang
details: The most powerful factory Mustang ever built. Its supercharged V8 screams through an active exhaust, while track-tuned suspension keeps it glued to the tarmac.

name: Chevrolet Camaro
details: A track-capable American muscle car. The ZL1 features a magnetic ride suspension and an aggressive aerodynamic package to harness its massive supercharged V8.

name: Dodge Challenger
details: The ultimate factory drag racer. Running on E85 ethanol, this Demon variant produces over 1,000 horsepower and features specialized drag radials for mind-bending quarter-mile times.

name: Ford F-150
details: A desert-running dune buggy disguised as a full-size pickup. The Raptor R uses a supercharged V8 to launch itself over sand dunes at terrifying speeds.

name: Ram 1500
details: The king of high-speed off-roading. Powered by a Hellcat V8 and sitting on 35-inch tires, the TRX obliterates dirt trails with unbelievable ferocity.

name: Toyota Supra
details: The entry point to Supra ownership. A lighter, more accessible version that still benefits from the brilliant chassis tuning of its larger 3.0L sibling.

name: Nissan 370Z
details: The final, most aggressive iteration of the Z34 generation. Features a naturally aspirated V6, Recaro seats, and a fiercely analog driving experience.

name: Subaru BRZ
details: A highly refined version of the affordable sports car formula. The tS adds STI-tuned dampers and flexible V-bar for superior cornering stability.

name: Honda S2000
details: A legendary high-revving roadster in its most focused form. The CR removes the soft top for weight savings and adds aggressive aero for pure track duty.

name: Mazda RX-7
details: The ultimate iteration of the rotary legend. Lightweight, incredibly balanced, and featuring a high-revving twin-turbo rotary engine that is uniquely intoxicating.

name: Lotus
details: An all-electric hypercar with nearly 2,000 horsepower. Its sculpted body acts as a ground-effect aerodynamic tunnel, producing massive downforce without bulky wings.

name: Pininfarina
details: An Italian-designed electric hypercar combining breathtaking beauty with extreme performance. Hand-built in very limited numbers, it channels instantaneous electric torque flawlessly.

name: Aspark
details: A Japanese-built, wedge-shaped electric hypercar designed specifically to be the fastest accelerating car in the world. It barely clears a speed bump but rockets down the quarter mile.

name: Czinger
details: A groundbreaking hypercar built using 3D-printed components and a hybrid in-line V8 architecture. Its twin-aircraft-style seating puts the driver dead center.

name: Gordon Murray
details: The spiritual successor to the McLaren F1. Features a central driving position, a manual gearbox, and a fan-assisted ground-effect system for unparalleled purity.

name: GMA
details: A more accessible, road-focused version of the T.50. It retains the bespoke high-revving V12 and manual transmission in a slightly larger, highly ergonomic package.

name: SSC
details: An American-built top-speed contender. Its twin-turbo V8 and incredibly slippery carbon fiber body are designed to break the 300 mph barrier.

name: Hennessey
details: A mad, American-engineered speed machine built with one goal: exceeding 300 mph. Its massive twin-turbo V8 produces an ungodly amount of furious power.

name: Apollo
details: An uncompromising, naturally aspirated track monster. Its aggressive, angular bodywork generates massive downforce while its V12 screams like a classic race car.

name: De Tomaso
details: A stunning retro-futuristic homage to 1970s endurance racers. Built around a carbon fiber chassis and powered by a supercharged Ford V8, it is rolling automotive art.

name: Tesla Model 3
details: The electric daily driver benchmark. Offers exhilarating acceleration, cutting-edge technology, and an expansive charging network at a relatively accessible price point.

name: Hyundai Ioniq 5
details: An electric hot hatch that simulates a traditional gearbox and provides simulated engine sounds. It brings N-brand track performance to the EV space brilliantly.

name: Kia EV6
details: A strikingly designed electric crossover with genuine performance credentials. Its 800-volt architecture allows for ultra-fast charging and blistering acceleration.

name: BMW i4
details: An electric sedan that successfully captures the spirit of the M Division. Delivers explosive rear-biased power and classic BMW driving dynamics in a zero-emissions package.

name: Tesla
details: A polarizing, stainless-steel exoskeleton truck that looks like it drove off a movie set. Offers brutal acceleration and utility in a completely unconventional package.

name: Rivian
details: The world's first electric pickup truck built for genuine off-roading. Features a gear tunnel, a camp kitchen option, and massive power for overlanding.

name: Ford Mustang
details: The most track-capable naturally aspirated Mustang ever. Features a flat-plane crank V8, aggressive aero, and a standard 6-speed manual for pure driving joy.

name: Toyota GR Supra
details: A special manual-transmission-only edition of the GR Supra. Features unique Cognac leather and a handful of lightweight parts to celebrate the return of the stick shift.

name: Porsche 911
details: A bizarre, brilliant fusion of a 911 sports car and a rally raid vehicle. Raised suspension, all-terrain tires, and auxiliary lights make it an off-road anomaly.

name: Lamborghini Huracán
details: The sweet spot in the Huracán lineup. Combines the aggressive rear-wheel-drive dynamics of the STO with the everyday comfort of the standard car, wrapped in a striking look.

name: Lamborghini Huracán
details: The world's first supercar designed for loose surfaces. Raised suspension, reinforced underbody, and all-terrain tires turn the Huracán into an unstoppable rally beast.

name: Ferrari 296 GTB
details: A plug-in hybrid V6 that rewrites the supercar rulebook. The turbocharged 120° V6 paired with an electric motor delivers V8-rivaling power with a unique, intoxicating sound.

name: Porsche Macan
details: A sports car disguised as an SUV. The Macan GTS features a raspy twin-turbo V6, adaptive air suspension, and a chassis that defies its tall stance.

name: BMW X3 M
details: A brutally fast compact SUV that handles like a sports sedan. The S58 twin-turbo inline-six delivers relentless mid-range thrust and a signature BMW Motorsport exhaust note.

name: Mercedes-AMG GLE 63
details: A family hauler with supercar credentials. The handcrafted 4.0L biturbo V8 propels this two-ton SUV to 60 mph in under 3.8 seconds with stadium-seating luxury.

name: Audi RS Q8
details: The Nürburgring SUV lap record holder. Combines Quattro all-wheel drive, air suspension, and a twin-turbo V8 to create an embarrassingly fast luxury crossover.

name: Alfa Romeo Giulia
details: One of the best-driving sedans ever made. A Ferrari-derived twin-turbo V6, carbon fiber driveshaft, and near-perfect steering make it a true driver's car.

name: Toyota Land Cruiser
details: An indestructible icon returning to its roots. The new Land Cruiser pairs a hybrid V6 with legendary off-road capability in a smaller, more focused package.

name: Jeep Wrangler
details: A 6.4L HEMI V8 stuffed into a Wrangler. The Rubicon 392 is absurdly fast off-road and on, combining rock-crawling ability with burnout-inducing power.

name: Ford F-150
details: The most powerful F-150 ever built. A supercharged 5.2L V8 from the Shelby GT500 makes this desert-running truck absolutely terrifying in a straight line.

name: Ram 1500
details: A hell-raising truck with a supercharged HEMI heart. Bilstein shocks, 35-inch tires, and launch control make it the fastest production pickup in its class.

name: Chevrolet Camaro
details: The ultimate Camaro. A supercharged 6.2L V8, magnetic ride control, and an available 10-speed automatic or 6-speed manual make it devastating on road and track.

name: Ford Mustang
details: The most track-capable 5.0L Mustang ever. Flat-plane crank vibes, Tremec 6-speed manual, and track-ready aerodynamics make it a proper canyon carver.

name: Shelby GT500
details: The most powerful factory Mustang ever produced. Its 5.2L supercharged cross-plane V8 and race-derived aero package create a genuine supercar slayer.

name: Nissan Skyline GT-R
details: The holy grail of Japanese performance. The RB26DETT inline-six and ATTESA E-TS AWD system created an uncontested racing legend that dominated circuits worldwide.

name: Toyota AE86
details: The car that launched a million drift dreams. Its lightweight RWD chassis and high-revving 4A-GE engine made it the ultimate touge weapon and pop culture icon.

name: Mazda RX-7
details: The pinnacle of rotary engineering. The sequential twin-turbo 13B-REW engine delivers power as smoothly as it consumes apex seals, wrapped in timeless Japanese design.

name: Honda S2000
details: A 9,000 RPM symphony on wheels. The F22C1 engine holds the record for highest specific output of a naturally aspirated production car—an engineering marvel.

name: Subaru Impreza
details: The rarest and most coveted STI ever made. Only 424 were built to celebrate Subaru's 40th anniversary and three consecutive WRC manufacturer titles.

name: Mitsubishi Lancer
details: Built to honor a four-time WRC champion. The TME features a titanium turbo, Recaro seats, and the most refined AYC system of the Evo VI generation.

name: McLaren 720S
details: A breathtaking demonstration of aerodynamic ingenuity. The 'eye-hole' air intake and double-skinned doors create immense downforce without visible wings.

name: Ferrari SF90
details: Ferrari's first plug-in hybrid production car. Three electric motors supplement a twin-turbo V8 to create the most powerful road-going Ferrari ever.

name: Lamborghini Revuelto
details: The successor to the Aventador. A naturally aspirated V12 mated to three electric motors creates the first hybrid Lamborghini flagship with over 1,000 horsepower.

name: Aston Martin Valkyrie
details: A road-legal F1 car co-developed with Red Bull Racing. Its naturally aspirated 6.5L Cosworth V12 revs to 11,100 RPM—a number that defies belief.

name: Mercedes-AMG ONE
details: A literal Formula 1 engine for the road. The 1.6L turbo V6 hybrid powertrain is derived directly from Lewis Hamilton's championship-winning race car.

name: Gordon Murray T.50
details: The spiritual successor to the McLaren F1. A 12,100 RPM naturally aspirated V3.9L V12 and a fan-assisted ground effect system create pure, analogue perfection.

name: Koenigsegg Jesko
details: Designed to be the fastest car ever. On E85 fuel, the twin-turbo V8 produces an earth-shattering 1,600 HP aimed at breaking the 300 mph barrier.

name: Bugatti Tourbillon
details: The Chiron's successor. A new naturally aspirated V16 hybrid engine produces 1,800 HP, marking a radical departure from Bugatti's quad-turbo W16 legacy.

name: Pagani Utopia
details: Art and engineering in perfect harmony. A twin-turbo Mercedes-AMG V12 paired with a proper 7-speed manual option makes it a purist's dream hypercar.

name: Hennessey Venom F5
details: Built with one singular mission: exceed 300 mph. Its furious twin-turbo V8 and radical aerodynamics push the absolute limits of terrestrial velocity.

name: Lotus Eletre
details: Lotus's first SUV and first electric car. Dual motors, active aerodynamics, and a carbon fiber roof prove that EV SUVs can be genuinely thrilling.

name: Rivian R1T
details: The world's first electric pickup truck. A quad-motor setup with tank turn capability, integrated camp kitchen, and genuine off-road prowess.

name: Tesla Cybertruck
details: An alien spacecraft parked on Earth. Stainless steel exoskeleton, armor glass, and brutal tri-motor acceleration make it the most unconventional truck ever built.

name: Lucid Gravity
details: Lucid's space-age SUV. Ultra-efficient motors, a massive curved glass canopy, and over 440 miles of range in an aerodynamically optimized package.

name: BMW iX
details: A technological flagship SUV. Shy Tech hidden interfaces, a massive curved display, and brutal electric acceleration wrapped in polarizing design.

name: Mercedes-Benz EQE
details: An electric luxury SUV with the Hyperscreen. Serene, fast, and beautifully built—it brings S-class vibes to the mid-size EV SUV segment.

name: Porsche Cayenne
details: The fastest SUV around the Nürburgring. A twin-turbo V8, carbon fiber everywhere, and chassis tuning that makes this heavy SUV handle like a sports car.

name: Lamborghini Urus
details: The angry Urus. Increased turbo boost, carbon fiber body panels, and a track-tuned chassis make the world's first Super SUV even more unhinged.

name: BMW XM
details: The most powerful BMW ever made. A plug-in hybrid V8 with outrageous styling and a massive 195 HP electric motor creating a truly unique luxury performance statement.

name: Ferrari Purosangue
details: Ferrari's controversial first four-door, four-seat car. A naturally aspirated V8, suicide doors, and a transaxle-mounted gearbox preserve the Ferrari driving experience.

name: Aston Martin DBX707
details: The most powerful luxury SUV. A heavily tuned AMG V8 with wet clutch AWD launches this beautiful brute to 60 in 3.1 seconds.

name: Maserati Levante
details: An Italian luxury SUV with a Ferrari-built V8. The Levante Trofeo combines Maserati grand touring comfort with genuine supercar power.

name: Bentley Bentayga
details: The fastest Bentley SUV. Handcrafted wood and leather interiors mask a W12 engine that makes this two-and-a-half-ton land yacht embarrassingly quick.

name: Rolls-Royce Cullinan
details: The pinnacle of SUV luxury. A twin-turbo V12, self-closing doors, starlight headliner, and a viewing suite with leather seats that deploy from the trunk.

name: Dodge Challenger
details: The ultimate factory drag racer. On E85, this supercharged HEMI produces over 1,000 HP and can pull 1.66g off the line with its transbrake launch system.

name: Chevrolet Camaro
details: A purpose-built NHRA drag racer. Not street legal, but its naturally aspirated 427 V8 and full roll cage make it the ultimate quarter-mile weapon.

name: Nissan Silvia
details: The final and most refined Silvia. Its SR20DET turbo engine and lightweight body made it the go-to platform for drift builds worldwide.

name: Toyota Supra
details: The car that defined an era. The 2JZ-GTE inline-six became the most tunable engine in history, making the Mk4 Supra an immortal performance icon.

name: Honda NSX
details: The supercar that humbled Ferrari. Ayrton Senna helped develop its aluminum chassis and VTEC V6, creating a paradigm shift in what a supercar could be.

name: Mazda Savanna RX-7
details: The 80s Japanese wedge that started the rotary legend. Its turbocharged 13B engine and pop-up headlights made it an icon of Japanese performance.

name: Porsche 911
details: A 911 built for the desert. Raised suspension, all-terrain tires, and rally-inspired livery make this the most adventurous 911 ever conceived.

name: Porsche 911
details: The everyday hypercar. 640 HP from a twin-turbo flat-six, all-wheel drive, and launch control that pins you to your seat with brutal efficiency.

name: Ferrari 812
details: The most powerful naturally aspirated production V8 car ever. Its 6.5L V12 screams to 9,500 RPM with a ferocity that brings tears to enthusiasts' eyes.

name: Lamborghini Countach
details: A retro-futuristic revival of the most iconic Lambo shape. Hybrid V12 power meets 1980s wedge design in a limited-run homage to automotive legend.

name: McLaren Speedtail
details: The spiritual successor to the F1. A three-seat layout, flexible carbon body panels, and a hybrid powertrain push the top speed to 250 mph.

name: Pininfarina Battista
details: The most powerful Italian car ever built. Four electric motors produce nearly 1,900 HP in a stunning carbon fiber body designed by the legendary Pininfarina.

name: Lotus Evija
details: The most powerful production car ever with nearly 2,000 HP. Porous bodywork channels air through the car itself, creating active ground-effect aerodynamics.

name: De Tomaso P72
details: A retro-futuristic jewel. Inspired by the 1970s P70 prototype, its hand-formed aluminum body wraps around a Ford GT supercharged V8.

name: Czinger 21C
details: 3D-printed construction meets hybrid insanity. AI-designed and robotically assembled, the 21C represents the bleeding edge of automotive manufacturing.

name: SSC Tuatara
details: An American hypercar built for top speed supremacy. Its twin-turbo flat-plane crank V8 produces up to 1,750 HP on E85 with incredible aerodynamic efficiency.

name: Volkswagen Golf
details: A limited-edition GTI celebrating 45 years of the hot hatch. Akrapovič exhaust, sharper suspension, and a manual option make it a proper sendoff.

name: Ford Focus
details: The wildest Focus ever. Drift mode, a turbocharged inline-four, and an AWD system that can send 70% of torque to the rear wheels.

name: Renault Mégane
details: The FWD Nürburgring king. Carbon fiber wheels, no rear seats, and a manually adjustable Öhlins suspension make it a barely street-legal track weapon.

name: Peugeot 208
details: A chic French hot hatch. Its punchy 1.6L turbo and lightweight chassis deliver an effortlessly stylish and fun driving experience.

name: Toyota Yaris
details: A tiny rocket with rally DNA. The 1.6L three-cylinder turbo and GR-FOUR AWD system make it the most fun you can have at any speed.

name: Mini John Cooper Works
details: The most extreme Mini ever. No rear seats, aggressive aero, and a tuned 2.0L turbo create a pocket-sized track terror with huge personality.

name: SEAT León
details: Spain's fiery hot hatch. The Cupra 290 pairs a VAQ limited-slip differential with a turbocharged engine for an engaging, affordable performance experience.

name: Dacia Duster
details: Proof that fun doesn't require a big budget. A lightweight body, simple AWD system, and a naturally aspirated engine create honest, no-frills adventure.

name: Suzuki Jimny
details: An adorable off-road legend. Its ladder-frame chassis, solid axles, and low-range gearbox make it a surprisingly capable trail explorer.

name: Ford Bronco
details: A desert-running beast with a turbo V6, long-travel FOX Live Valve shocks, and 37-inch tires. It jumps dunes like a trophy truck.

name: Ineos Grenadier
details: A no-nonsense, body-on-frame 4x4 built for people who miss the old Land Rover Defender. BMW straight-six power meets uncompromising utility.

name: Land Rover Defender
details: A V8 in a boxy British icon. The Defender V8 combines legendary off-road capability with supercar-rivaling acceleration and premium luxury.

name: Mercedes-Benz G-Class
details: A luxury tank with a V8 soundtrack. Three locking differentials, portal axles, and an AMG-tuned biturbo V8 make it the most desirable box on wheels.

name: Lexus GX
details: A luxury off-roader with genuine capability. The Overtrail package adds lockers, 33-inch tires, and a kinematic dynamic suspension system.

name: Cadillac Escalade-V
details: A 6,000-pound luxury barge with a supercharged V8. Magnetic ride control and 10-speed transmission make it shockingly capable for its size.

name: Lincoln Navigator
details: American luxury at its most spacious. Glide suspension, a 30-way seat massage, and a massive panoramic screen define first-class travel.

name: Range Rover
details: The definitive luxury SUV. Ceramic-coated paint, hand-finished wood veneers, and a plug-in hybrid V8 create the most opulent off-roader imaginable.

name: Volvo XC90
details: Scandinavian luxury meets electrification. A crystal gear shifter, Bowers & Wilkins audio, and a plug-in hybrid powertrain define understated elegance.

name: Polestar 3
details: A Swedish electric performance SUV with minimalist design and LiDAR-equipped autonomous driving hardware built straight into the roof.

name: Rivian R1S
details: An electric 3-row SUV with genuine off-road credibility. Quad motors, a camp kitchen option, and over 320 miles of range for family adventures.

name: Maserati GranTurismo
details: The first electric Maserati. A triple-motor setup delivers over 750 HP with a sound generator that mimics a V8 exhaust note—a fascinating engineering compromise.

name: Porsche Taycan
details: The entry point to electric Porsche performance. Still devastatingly quick with the same brilliant chassis and that signature Porsche driving feel.

name: BMW i4
details: An electric M car that genuinely delivers. Dual motors, M Sport brakes, and a chassis tuned at the Nürburgring create a convincing electric performance sedan.

name: Hyundai Ioniq 6
details: An aerodynamically stunning electric streamliner. Its 0.21 Cd drag coefficient and 800V architecture enable ultra-fast charging and exceptional range.

name: Kia EV6
details: An electric hot hatch on steroids. 576 HP, a drift mode, and 800V ultra-fast charging make it one of the most exciting EVs at any price.

name: Nissan Ariya
details: Nissan's electric performance SUV. NISMO-tuned suspension, distinctive aero, and a dual-motor powertrain bring the ZEED platform to life.

name: Chevrolet Equinox
details: An affordable electric SUV that doesn't compromise. 300 miles of range, fast charging, and sharp styling at a price that brings EVs to the masses.

name: Ford Mustang Mach-E
details: The electric Mustang that sparked controversy. The GT version backs up its name with genuine performance, including a 3.5-second 0-60 and track mode.

name: Volkswagen ID.4
details: VW's electric performance SUV. The GTX badge returns with dual motors, sporty suspension tuning, and a clean, tech-forward interior.

name: Skoda Enyaq
details: A practical electric SUV with RS performance DNA. Spacious interior, fast charging, and a punchy dual-motor setup at a surprisingly reasonable price.

name: Honda Civic
details: The previous-generation Type R that conquered the FWD Nürburgring record. Its aggressive wing and triple exhaust became an instant automotive icon.

name: Mazda 6
details: A beautifully styled mid-size sedan with a turbocharged heart. Kodo design philosophy makes it one of the most elegant cars in its class.

name: Nissan Altima
details: Features the world's first production variable compression turbo engine. The VC-Turbo adjusts its compression ratio on the fly for optimal power or efficiency.

name: Kia K5
details: A strikingly designed sport sedan. The GT trim adds a turbocharged engine and a sport-tuned suspension to Kia's most stylish four-door.

name: Mitsubishi Eclipse
details: A sporty compact SUV with rally-inspired S-AWC all-wheel drive. Sharp handling and aggressive styling bring some excitement to the crossover segment.

name: Subaru BRZ
details: The BRZ with track-focused STI tuning. Hitachi dampers, Brembo brakes, and a stiffened chassis extract maximum performance from the naturally aspirated flat-four.

name: Nissan 400Z
details: The Z car gets the Nismo treatment. Recaro seats, Dunlop Sport Maxx tires, and a retuned twin-turbo V6 make this the most focused Z ever.

name: Toyota Crown
details: Japan's legendary nameplate returns as a lifted hybrid sedan. Premium materials, a refined hybrid powertrain, and a unique silhouette define it.

name: Infiniti Q60
details: A beautiful grand touring coupe with a potent twin-turbo V6. Digital suspension and a luxurious interior make it a stylish alternative to European rivals.

name: Lexus RC F
details: A naturally aspirated V8 coupe built for the track. Carbon fiber components, Brembo carbon ceramic brakes, and a 7,300 RPM redline deliver pure, old-school thrills.
